name: Bloodtrail Cub
rules: Bloodied - Bloodtrail Cub has +2 STR while attacking.
art_target: Lean bloodtrail cub under a red moon, low predatory posture with fresh scar-lines glowing when it lunges.

name: Scar Dancer
rules: Bloodied - After Scar Dancer deals damage and its universal 2-HP restore resolves, you may deal 1 damage to Scar Dancer.
art_target: Scar dancer twisting through combat with elegant claw arcs, willingly reopening a small wound after feeding.

name: Pale Leech
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Pale Leech restores HP from dealing damage, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Pale leech-like lunar beast drinking life from a strike while a card-shaped moon glyph emerges from the restored energy.

name: Redjaw Raider
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Redjaw Raider deals combat damage, it gains +1 maximum HP permanently without restoring HP.
art_target: Broad red-jawed raider with scarred hide and heavy forelimbs, growing tougher each time bloodied combat lands.

name: Woundrunner
rules: Bloodied - Woundrunner has +2 STR while attacking an already-damaged enemy creature.
art_target: Woundrunner built for pursuit, long-legged moon predator focusing ruthlessly on an already-injured target.

name: Mercy Eater
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round another friendly Moondemon restores HP, Mercy Eater gains +1 STR this round and takes 1 damage.
art_target: Gaunt mercy eater watching an ally heal, then cutting itself as stolen vigor turns into temporary aggression.

name: Moonclaw Duelist
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Moonclaw Duelist survives creature combat and remains Bloodied, it may immediately make one additional attack.
art_target: Moonclaw duelist surviving a brutal exchange and immediately wheeling into a second attack under lunar light.

name: Veinbreaker
rules: Bloodied - Before Veinbreaker attacks, you may deal 1 damage to it. If you do, it gains +3 STR for that combat.
art_target: Veinbreaker deliberately scoring its own hide before a charge, red energy flooding into oversized attacking claws.

name: Hunger Matriarch
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round another Bloodied friendly Moondemon deals damage, restore 1 additional HP to that creature after its universal restore.
art_target: Hunger matriarch looming behind a wounded pack, feeding restorative moonlight back into bloodied hunters.

name: Nightpack Alpha
rules: Bloodied - Other Bloodied friendly Moondemons have +1 STR.
art_target: Nightpack alpha at the center of several bloodied packmates, its presence sharpening every nearby silhouette.

name: Eclipse Ravager
rules: Bloodied - Whenever Eclipse Ravager destroys an enemy creature in combat, deal 1 damage to every other enemy creature. Eclipse Ravager is the source of that damage.
art_target: Eclipse ravager tearing through one enemy as a crescent shockwave clips the rest of the opposing line.

name: Moonfang Sovereign
rules: Bloodied - Moonfang Sovereign deals +3 damage on direct attacks. After it attacks, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: Moonfang sovereign, huge regal lunar predator with silver fangs and blood-red mane, poised for a devastating direct strike.

name: Ward Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally would receive damage, reveal: prevent all of that damage, then give it Shield equal to the prevented damage.
art_target: Ward Sigil as a carved lunar talisman flaring open into a silver shield at the instant damage would land.

name: Bloodwake Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally becomes Bloodied, reveal: it gains +3 STR this round and Shield 2.
art_target: Bloodwake Sigil: hidden blood-moon glyph igniting the instant a wounded ally crosses into Bloodied state.

name: Fang Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally attacks while Bloodied, reveal: it gains +3 STR for that combat.
art_target: Fang Sigil: compact moonbone rune revealing beneath a charging bloodied predator, feeding power directly into its jaws.

name: Reprisal Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally survives combat damage from an enemy creature, reveal: deal 2 damage to that enemy after combat.
art_target: Reprisal Sigil: retaliatory crescent glyph flashing after an ally survives a hit, sending force back toward the attacker.

name: Redline Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally would heal to full after having been Bloodied, reveal: leave it at 1 HP below maximum instead and it permanently gains +1 STR / +1 maximum HP.
art_target: Redline Sigil: thin crimson lunar seal stopping healing one step short of full while permanent scars harden into power.

name: Feast Sigil
signature_detail: Face-down attachment; reveal on printed trigger
rules: SIGIL — Attach face-down to a friendly Moondemon. When that ally destroys an enemy creature in combat, reveal: restore 3 HP to it, then draw 1 card and put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Feast Sigil: predatory moon glyph opening over a defeated enemy, pouring healing and a single card-fragment into the victor.

name: Blood in the Water
rules: After an enemy creature takes damage and survives, Bloodied - Choose a Bloodied friendly Moondemon. Its next attack this round gains +2 STR for that combat.
art_target: Trap scene of blood spreading through dark water while a bloodied hunter locks onto the newly wounded enemy.

name: Last Bite
rules: When a Bloodied friendly Moondemon is destroyed by an enemy creature, deal 2 damage to that enemy. Bloodied - Another Bloodied friendly Moondemon gains +2 maximum HP permanently without restoring HP.
art_target: A dying packmate snapping one last bite at its killer while another survivor grows larger in the background.

name: Goremane Pup
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Goremane Pup takes damage, it gains +1 STR this round.
art_target: Small goremane pup recoiling from a hit as its mane flares brighter and its stance becomes more aggressive.

name: Crimson Surgeon
rules: Bloodied - Once per round, deal 1 damage to another friendly Moondemon. That creature gains +1 maximum HP permanently without restoring HP and +1 STR this round.
art_target: Crimson surgeon tending a packmate with deliberate claw-work, trading a controlled wound for lasting toughness.

name: Dusk Butcher
rules: Bloodied - When Dusk Butcher attacks a damaged enemy creature, it gains +2 STR for that combat.
art_target: Dusk butcher stalking a wounded enemy through blue-black twilight, heavy cleaver-like claws brightening before impact.

name: Ravine Stalker
rules: Bloodied - When Ravine Stalker attacks a damaged enemy creature, it does not take retaliation damage from that combat.
art_target: Ravine stalker springing from shadow onto an already-damaged foe, positioned to evade all retaliation.

name: Pale Moon Tyrant
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round another friendly Moondemon becomes Bloodied, that creature gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Pale moon tyrant towering over newly bloodied packmates, red lunar light surging through the first one to cross the threshold.

name: Vespera, Redfang Matriarch
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Vespera deals damage, you may redirect up to 2 HP of her universal restore to another friendly Moondemon. BLOODTHIRST - The Pack Drinks Together: the first Moondemon destroyed by Bloodthirst each round gives +3 STR / +3 maximum and current HP to every other friendly Moondemon instead of +2/+2. FRENZIED - Redline: the first time each round a Bloodied friendly Moondemon would return to full HP and be destroyed by Frenzied, deal 1 damage to it before the full-HP death check.
art_target: Vespera as the legendary redfang matriarch: enormous scarred lunar queen, silver-red mane, commanding a pack through controlled blood and healing.

name: Blood Price
rules: Lose 2 Health. Gain 3 resources this round. Bloodied - If you control a Bloodied Moondemon, one Bloodied friendly Moondemon gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Blood-price ritual where player life drains into three bright resource motes while one bloodied hunter gains temporary ferocity.

name: Pack Feeding
rules: Restore 2 HP to up to three friendly Moondemons. Bloodied - For each Bloodied target, you may replace 1 of that healing with +1 maximum HP permanently without restoring that point.
art_target: Pack-feeding scene with healing divided among three distinct Moondemons, one converting part of the glow into permanent scarred growth.

name: Moonrage
rules: Bloodied - All Bloodied friendly Moondemons gain +2 STR this round. After each of those creatures takes a combat action, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: Moonrage sweeping across an entire bloodied pack, every creature surging forward as self-damaging red lunar fire follows their actions.

name: Predator's Reprisal
rules: When an enemy creature destroys one of your creatures, Bloodied - Choose another Bloodied friendly Moondemon. If it has not acted this round, it may immediately attack that enemy. After the attack, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: Predator’s Reprisal: one fallen packmate foregrounded while another bloodied hunter immediately counterattacks the killer.
